description:
HUD Fair Market Rents (studio to 4 bedrooms, monthly) for one US county, for the current HUD fiscal year and
        the previous one, which year is in effect, the 90-110% voucher payment standard range, whether the area is a
        HUD-designated Small Area FMR metro, and the state and national medians.
        `state`: two-letter code or name. `county`: name or FIPS ("Harris", "Cook County", "17031"). New England counties
        list each HUD area with its towns.
name: fair_market_rent_by_county
